raw.description: 战斗开始时，自身进入事象观测状态；自身受到致死伤害时，退出事象观测以消除对手的能力提升状态、回合类效果并重生|自身登场之后，记录当回合自身首个进入的异常状态和对手所使用技能的类型，记录成功则当回合结束时解除自身所处的异常状态；自身的技能命中时，若类型与自身记录的技能类型相同则附加自身记录的异常状态，未触发则令自身凝滞|战斗阶段结束时，若对手处于异常状态则自身特攻、速度+1且下回合使用技能时附加特攻值40%的百分比伤害，若对手不处于异常状态则恢复自身最大体力的1/4|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 观测最后即时重生、登场当回合记录覆盖、任一记录成功回末清异常均按原始回答实现；当前双版本自身强化无虚构延期。
review.singleBehavior: 初始进入事象观测；其他保命/重生未存活后致死立即退出，清敌正强及回合并满HP/PP，自身状态不额外重置。仅登场回合记自身首个实际异常和对手技能类型，覆盖观测既有记录；观测仍在缺槽时记录敌异常和己技能类型，任意记录成功当回末清自身异常。类型匹配命中附记录异常，失败自身凝滞；两版真实40/60%面板特攻粉伤与1/4、1/3回复/先制保留。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场时记录条件重建及跨下场记录保留，按已确认的真实生命周期实现。
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场记录生命周期

success.name: 4915双版2100真实初始观测与双方同类型首轮无冲突记录、缺记录命中凝滞及回末两项齐全清除
success.assertion: test('4915双版2100真实初始观测与双方同类型首轮无冲突记录、缺记录命中凝滞及回末两项齐全清除',()=>{const s=make({move:12897,soul:true});assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(st(s).active,true);let held;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)held=c.a.ailments['凝滞'];},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.ok(held>=1);assert.equal(st(s).status,'凝滞');assert.equal(st(s).kind,'physical');assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],undefined);});

success.name: 4915双版2100观测无记录时真实敌异常填槽并按记录类型附加，已存在记录不被观测覆盖
success.assertion: test('4915双版2100观测无记录时真实敌异常填槽并按记录类型附加，已存在记录不被观测覆盖',()=>{const s=make({move:12897,soul:true});Object.assign(st(s),{kind:'physical'});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(st(s).status,'烧伤');assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],undefined);assert.equal(st(s).events[0].origin,'observation');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(st(s).status,'烧伤');});

success.name: 4915双版2100战斗阶段敌有异常特攻速度一且次轮用招面板百分比不计能力等级，MISS实际用招仍附伤
success.assertion: test('4915双版2100战斗阶段敌有异常特攻速度一且次轮用招面板百分比不计能力等级，MISS实际用招仍附伤',()=>{for(const level of[-2,0,2]){const s=make({move:12897,soul:true,aStats:{spa:500},loadout:[12897,21506,29378,29379,38433]});Object.assign(st(s),{status:'凝滞',kind:'physical'});s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞']=9;turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,1);s.fighters[0].stages.spa=level;delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),id===2100?200:300);}});

success.name: 4915双版2100无敌异常魂印回复四分一或三分一、强化版下回先制1，技能禁疗不挡而回复倍率仍作用
success.assertion: test('4915双版2100无敌异常魂印回复四分一或三分一、强化版下回先制1，技能禁疗不挡而回复倍率仍作用',()=>{for(const cut of[false,true]){const s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[21506,12897,29378,29379,38433]});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(cut)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,21506,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(id===2100?2250:3000)*(cut?.5:1));turn(s,21506,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,id===2108?1:0);}});

success.name: 4915双版2100真实MISS不附凝滞，致死即时重生与登场类型覆盖按已答执行
success.assertion: test('4915双版2100真实MISS不附凝滞，致死即时重生与登场类型覆盖按已答执行',()=>{const miss=make({move:12897,soul:true});delete miss.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(miss,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(miss,12897,10127);assert.equal(st(miss).status,null);for(const mode of['lethal','conflict']){const s=make({move:12897,soul:true,hp:mode==='lethal'?1:9000,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:mode==='lethal'?9999:180}});if(mode==='conflict')st(s).kind='status';turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(st(s).kind,'physical');assert.equal(st(s).active,mode!=='lethal');assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0);if(mode==='lethal')assert.equal(st(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

success.name: 4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生
success.assertion: test('4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,'probe');timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'观测真实致死探针',type);if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0&&!captured)captured={hp:c.a.hp,pp:{...c.a.pp},atk:c.a.stages.atk,burn:c.a.ailments['烧伤'],active:c.a.soulState.observation4915.active};},()=>turn(s,21506,type==='attack'?10127:20309));assert.equal(captured.hp,9000);assert.equal(captured.active,false);assert.equal(captured.atk,-2);assert.ok(captured.burn);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.probe,undefined);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(21506)],s.moveDefinitions[key(21506)].pp-1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'第二次致死',type==='attack'?'fixed':type);},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

success.name: 4915已答观测重生最后触发：保1/一次保命/技能即时重生/技能死亡回复先保活则观测保持，再次致死才退出
success.assertion: test('4915已答观测重生最后触发：保1/一次保命/技能即时重生/技能死亡回复先保活则观测保持，再次致死才退出',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const mode of['floor','once-floor','rebirth','skill-recover']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});if(mode==='floor')timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='once-floor')s.fighters[0].soulState.nextLethalFloor=true;if(mode==='rebirth')s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};if(mode==='skill-recover')timer(s,0,'死亡时技能回复');let active;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0)active=c.a.soulState.observation4915.active;},()=>turn(s,21506,10127));assert.equal(active,true);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,0);delete s.fighters[0].effects['致命保留'];turn(s,21506,10127);assert.equal(state(s).active,false);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

success.name: 4915已答登场记录覆盖先前观测内容，仅登场回合更新：首个自身异常锁定、敌技能类型按实际事件覆盖，之后不刷新
success.assertion: test('4915已答登场记录覆盖先前观测内容，仅登场回合更新：首个自身异常锁定、敌技能类型按实际事件覆盖，之后不刷新',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108]){const {make,turn}=H(id),s=make({move:12897,soul:true});Object.assign(state(s),{status:'烧伤',kind:'status'});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.ailment(c.a,'冻伤',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(state(s).status,'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'physical');assert.ok(state(s).events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote&&e.previous==='烧伤'));assert.ok(state(s).events.some(e=>e.field==='kind'&&e.overwrote&&e.previous==='status'));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,20117));assert.equal(state(s).status,'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'physical');assert.equal(state(s).recordRound,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);}});

success.name: 4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入
success.assertion: test('4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const mode of['status-only','kind-only','none','late-observation']){const {make,turn}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true});if(mode==='kind-only'||mode==='none')s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode==='late-observation'){turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,null);assert.equal(state(s).status,null);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(state(s).recordRound,2);assert.equal(state(s).status,'烧伤');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'status');assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});continue;}observe((e,c)=>{if(mode==='status-only'&&e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,null,mode==='kind-only'?20117:null));assert.equal(state(s).status,mode==='status-only'?'中毒':null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,mode==='kind-only'?'status':null);if(mode==='none')assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);else assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

success.name: 4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理
success.assertion: test('4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const immune of[false,true]){const {make,turn}=H(id),old=E.SOULS;let s;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0){if(immune)c.a.counts.immune=1;c.entrySelfAilment('中毒',3);}}};try{s=make({move:21506,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(state(s).status,immune?null:'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).entryRecords?.status??false,!immune);turn(s,null,20117);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

failure.assertion: test('4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,'probe');timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'观测真实致死探针',type);if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0&&!captured)captured={hp:c.a.hp,pp:{...c.a.pp},atk:c.a.stages.atk,burn:c.a.ailments['烧伤'],active:c.a.soulState.observation4915.active};},()=>turn(s,21506,type==='attack'?10127:20309));assert.equal(captured.hp,9000);assert.equal(captured.active,false);assert.equal(captured.atk,-2);assert.ok(captured.burn);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.probe,undefined);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(21506)],s.moveDefinitions[key(21506)].pp-1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'第二次致死',type==='attack'?'fixed':type);},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

interaction.assertion: test('4915双版2100观测无记录时真实敌异常填槽并按记录类型附加，已存在记录不被观测覆盖',()=>{const s=make({move:12897,soul:true});Object.assign(st(s),{kind:'physical'});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(st(s).status,'烧伤');assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['烧伤']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['凝滞'],undefined);assert.equal(st(s).events[0].origin,'observation');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(st(s).status,'烧伤');});

interaction.name: 4915双版2100战斗阶段敌有异常特攻速度一且次轮用招面板百分比不计能力等级，MISS实际用招仍附伤
interaction.assertion: test('4915双版2100战斗阶段敌有异常特攻速度一且次轮用招面板百分比不计能力等级，MISS实际用招仍附伤',()=>{for(const level of[-2,0,2]){const s=make({move:12897,soul:true,aStats:{spa:500},loadout:[12897,21506,29378,29379,38433]});Object.assign(st(s),{status:'凝滞',kind:'physical'});s.fighters[1].ailments['凝滞']=9;turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,1);s.fighters[0].stages.spa=level;delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(s,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),id===2100?200:300);}});

interaction.name: 4915双版2100无敌异常魂印回复四分一或三分一、强化版下回先制1，技能禁疗不挡而回复倍率仍作用
interaction.assertion: test('4915双版2100无敌异常魂印回复四分一或三分一、强化版下回先制1，技能禁疗不挡而回复倍率仍作用',()=>{for(const cut of[false,true]){const s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1000,loadout:[21506,12897,29378,29379,38433]});timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(cut)timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,21506,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+(id===2100?2250:3000)*(cut?.5:1));turn(s,21506,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,id===2108?1:0);}});

interaction.name: 4915双版2100真实MISS不附凝滞，致死即时重生与登场类型覆盖按已答执行
interaction.assertion: test('4915双版2100真实MISS不附凝滞，致死即时重生与登场类型覆盖按已答执行',()=>{const miss=make({move:12897,soul:true});delete miss.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];timer(miss,1,'概率闪避',{chance:100});turn(miss,12897,10127);assert.equal(st(miss).status,null);for(const mode of['lethal','conflict']){const s=make({move:12897,soul:true,hp:mode==='lethal'?1:9000,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:mode==='lethal'?9999:180}});if(mode==='conflict')st(s).kind='status';turn(s,12897,10127);assert.equal(st(s).kind,'physical');assert.equal(st(s).active,mode!=='lethal');assert.ok(s.fighters[0].hp>0);if(mode==='lethal')assert.equal(st(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生
interaction.assertion: test('4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,'probe');timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'观测真实致死探针',type);if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0&&!captured)captured={hp:c.a.hp,pp:{...c.a.pp},atk:c.a.stages.atk,burn:c.a.ailments['烧伤'],active:c.a.soulState.observation4915.active};},()=>turn(s,21506,type==='attack'?10127:20309));assert.equal(captured.hp,9000);assert.equal(captured.active,false);assert.equal(captured.atk,-2);assert.ok(captured.burn);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.probe,undefined);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(21506)],s.moveDefinitions[key(21506)].pp-1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'第二次致死',type==='attack'?'fixed':type);},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4915已答观测重生最后触发：保1/一次保命/技能即时重生/技能死亡回复先保活则观测保持，再次致死才退出
interaction.assertion: test('4915已答观测重生最后触发：保1/一次保命/技能即时重生/技能死亡回复先保活则观测保持，再次致死才退出',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const mode of['floor','once-floor','rebirth','skill-recover']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1},bStats:{atk:9999}});if(mode==='floor')timer(s,0,'致命保留',{hp:1});if(mode==='once-floor')s.fighters[0].soulState.nextLethalFloor=true;if(mode==='rebirth')s.fighters[0].soulState.rebirth2243={armed:true};if(mode==='skill-recover')timer(s,0,'死亡时技能回复');let active;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0)active=c.a.soulState.observation4915.active;},()=>turn(s,21506,10127));assert.equal(active,true);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,0);delete s.fighters[0].effects['致命保留'];turn(s,21506,10127);assert.equal(state(s).active,false);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4915已答登场记录覆盖先前观测内容，仅登场回合更新：首个自身异常锁定、敌技能类型按实际事件覆盖，之后不刷新
interaction.assertion: test('4915已答登场记录覆盖先前观测内容，仅登场回合更新：首个自身异常锁定、敌技能类型按实际事件覆盖，之后不刷新',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108]){const {make,turn}=H(id),s=make({move:12897,soul:true});Object.assign(state(s),{status:'烧伤',kind:'status'});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.ailment(c.a,'冻伤',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,12897,10127));assert.equal(state(s).status,'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'physical');assert.ok(state(s).events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote&&e.previous==='烧伤'));assert.ok(state(s).events.some(e=>e.field==='kind'&&e.overwrote&&e.previous==='status'));assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,12897,20117));assert.equal(state(s).status,'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'physical');assert.equal(state(s).recordRound,1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']);}});

interaction.name: 4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入
interaction.assertion: test('4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const mode of['status-only','kind-only','none','late-observation']){const {make,turn}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true});if(mode==='kind-only'||mode==='none')s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode==='late-observation'){turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,null);assert.equal(state(s).status,null);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(state(s).recordRound,2);assert.equal(state(s).status,'烧伤');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'status');assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});continue;}observe((e,c)=>{if(mode==='status-only'&&e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,null,mode==='kind-only'?20117:null));assert.equal(state(s).status,mode==='status-only'?'中毒':null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,mode==='kind-only'?'status':null);if(mode==='none')assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);else assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

interaction.name: 4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理
interaction.assertion: test('4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const immune of[false,true]){const {make,turn}=H(id),old=E.SOULS;let s;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0){if(immune)c.a.counts.immune=1;c.entrySelfAilment('中毒',3);}}};try{s=make({move:21506,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(state(s).status,immune?null:'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).entryRecords?.status??false,!immune);turn(s,null,20117);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

raw.description: 战斗开始时，自身进入事象观测状态；自身受到致死伤害时，退出事象观测以消除对手的能力提升状态、回合类效果并重生|自身登场之后，记录当回合自身首个进入的异常状态和对手所使用技能的类型，记录成功则当回合结束时解除自身所处的异常状态；自身的技能命中时，若类型与自身记录的技能类型相同则附加自身记录的异常状态，未触发则令自身凝滞|战斗阶段结束时，若对手处于异常状态则自身特攻、速度+1且下回合使用技能时附加特攻值60%的百分比伤害，若对手不处于异常状态则恢复自身最大体力的1/3且下回合技能先制+1|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 观测最后即时重生、登场当回合记录覆盖、任一记录成功回末清异常均按原始回答实现；当前双版本自身强化无虚构延期。
review.singleBehavior: 初始进入事象观测；其他保命/重生未存活后致死立即退出，清敌正强及回合并满HP/PP，自身状态不额外重置。仅登场回合记自身首个实际异常和对手技能类型，覆盖观测既有记录；观测仍在缺槽时记录敌异常和己技能类型，任意记录成功当回末清自身异常。类型匹配命中附记录异常，失败自身凝滞；两版真实40/60%面板特攻粉伤与1/4、1/3回复/先制保留。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实重新登场时记录条件重建及跨下场记录保留，按已确认的真实生命周期实现。
futureMechanisms: 真实再次登场记录生命周期

success.assertion: test('4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,'probe');timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'观测真实致死探针',type);if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0&&!captured)captured={hp:c.a.hp,pp:{...c.a.pp},atk:c.a.stages.atk,burn:c.a.ailments['烧伤'],active:c.a.soulState.observation4915.active};},()=>turn(s,21506,type==='attack'?10127:20309));assert.equal(captured.hp,9000);assert.equal(captured.active,false);assert.equal(captured.atk,-2);assert.ok(captured.burn);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.probe,undefined);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(21506)],s.moveDefinitions[key(21506)].pp-1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'第二次致死',type==='attack'?'fixed':type);},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

boundary.name: 4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生
boundary.assertion: test('4915已答两版致死立即退出观测重生满HP/PP，先清敌强化回合，保留自身记录负级异常，普通禁疗不改重生，第二次不重生',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const type of['attack','fixed','percent']){const {make,turn,timer}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true,hp:1,aStats:{def:1,spe:50},bStats:{atk:9999}});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=-2;s.fighters[0].ailments['烧伤']=3;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)s.fighters[0].pp[k]=2;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;timer(s,1,'probe');timer(s,0,'四杀鬼囹');let captured;observe((e,c)=>{if(type!=='attack'&&e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'观测真实致死探针',type);if(e==='damageTaken'&&c.a.side===0&&!captured)captured={hp:c.a.hp,pp:{...c.a.pp},atk:c.a.stages.atk,burn:c.a.ailments['烧伤'],active:c.a.soulState.observation4915.active};},()=>turn(s,21506,type==='attack'?10127:20309));assert.equal(captured.hp,9000);assert.equal(captured.active,false);assert.equal(captured.atk,-2);assert.ok(captured.burn);for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves)assert.equal(captured.pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.probe,undefined);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(21506)],s.moveDefinitions[key(21506)].pp-1);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100000,'第二次致死',type==='attack'?'fixed':type);},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(state(s).events.filter(e=>e.kind==='observation-rebirth').length,1);}});

interaction.name: 4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入
interaction.assertion: test('4915已答任一项记录成功即回末清自身异常；无新记录不清；观测缺槽可在后续回合首次填入',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const mode of['status-only','kind-only','none','late-observation']){const {make,turn}=H(id),s=make({move:21506,soul:true});if(mode==='kind-only'||mode==='none')s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']=4;if(mode==='late-observation'){turn(s,null,null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,null);assert.equal(state(s).status,null);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0){c.ailment(c.t,'烧伤',c.a,false,false,3);c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,21506,20309));assert.equal(state(s).recordRound,2);assert.equal(state(s).status,'烧伤');assert.equal(state(s).kind,'status');assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});continue;}observe((e,c)=>{if(mode==='status-only'&&e==='roundStart'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,null,mode==='kind-only'?20117:null));assert.equal(state(s).status,mode==='status-only'?'中毒':null);assert.equal(state(s).kind,mode==='kind-only'?'status':null);if(mode==='none')assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);else assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

interaction.name: 4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理
interaction.assertion: test('4915真实登场阶段首次异常也进入记录公共通道，免疫失败不记录，两版均在回末清理',()=>{for(const id of[2100,2108])for(const immune of[false,true]){const {make,turn}=H(id),old=E.SOULS;let s;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===0){if(immune)c.a.counts.immune=1;c.entrySelfAilment('中毒',3);}}};try{s=make({move:21506,soul:true});}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(state(s).status,immune?null:'中毒');assert.equal(state(s).entryRecords?.status??false,!immune);turn(s,null,20117);assert.deepEqual(s.fighters[0].ailments,{});}});

success.name: 4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖
success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.name: 4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖
success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.assertion: test('4915全部17招有序编译与64种子基础状态，两版原生17招及三种原冲突记录覆盖',()=>{require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify(B);for(const m of source.moves){const s=B.make({move:m.id}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));}for(const id of[2100,2108]){const snapshot=structuredClone(source);snapshot.souls=snapshot.souls.filter(x=>x.id===id);const H=require('./helpers/remaining-battle.cjs')(snapshot);for(const m of source.moves){const s=H.make({move:m.id,soul:true});s.fighters[1].counts.immune=100;H.turn(s,m.id,m.kind==='physical'?10127:m.kind==='special'?10716:20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulId,id);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}for(const move of[12905,12901,38433]){const s=H.make({move,soul:true}),m=source.moves.find(x=>x.id===move);H.turn(s,move,m.kind==='physical'?10127:10716);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.kind,m.kind);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].soulState.observation4915.events.some(e=>e.field==='status'&&e.overwrote));}}});

success.name: 4915/1978清强疲惫失败最大HP三分一附粉，2034清回合疲惫失败红减半
success.assertion: test('4915/1978清强疲惫失败最大HP三分一附粉，2034清回合疲惫失败红减半',()=>{for(const id of[1978,2034])for(const mode of['success','absent','immune']){const s=make(row(id));if(id===1978&&mode!=='absent')s.fighters[1].stages.def=1;if(id===2034&&mode==='absent')s.fighters[1].effects={};if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['疲惫'],mode==='success');if(id===1978)assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),mode==='success'?0:3000);else assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].effects['分类攻击减伤'],mode!=='success');}});
